**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).** It says roll back `dep-4471`.

Root cause is `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` in config gen 119. The gateway now grabs a fresh connection per request against a pool of 20, so it saturates and stays that way. Churn ran 4180 opens per 5m against a baseline of 40.

Impact ran `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z`, the end of the data. 530 of 1228 requests failed, 43%. Still broken when the log ends.

One caveat in the file. The log covers `node-3 of 3` only, so check the other two nodes.
